About

Network Security Engineer
Arab Payment Services — Baghdad

APS is a licensed Iraqi electronic payments company, regulated by the Central Bank of Iraq and a Mastercard-certified processor, operating Iraq's first local payment exchange network and PCI DSS-certified data center.

  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco switches, routers, and firewalls across Production, Hosting, UAT, and DR environments.
